answer: Resist sybils with a velocity-priced lock. Each new agent deposits one indivisible marble of stake, tied to a single key and sized to the registration delta of the last window, so a farm raises the next ticket. The deposit unlocks only after two paid settlements with unaffiliated, already-bonded counterparties. If later graph checks show shared treasuries or cloned clocks, the whole cluster is slashed. Auditors post no live feed an attacker can tune against; they whisper a signed finding to the registrar alone. Handles stay cheap; multiplying weight costs fresh capital and time per mask.
